title: Known-object test, TOI-2248.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-2248.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* ≤2.5, 3.5, ≤2.5, ≤2.5, 3, 3; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 1%, 1%, 1%, 1%, 1%, 1% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit not recovered, recovered (2 covered epochs). Residual screen: 231 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 6 light curve(s), forming 110 distinct event(s), 14 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2460013.7633 (ΔT 63.93 d); 1 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
